description: One script that sets the repo up on the given system: bash for macOS and Linux, PowerShell for Windows. It stops at the first error, skips what's already installed and never starts servers. Show it to the user to read before running it.

repo.description: The GitHub repo: "owner/repo" or a github.com link, e.g. "ollama/ollama".

name: get_setup_script
title: Get a repo's setup script
